questions: Does the sensor layout provide sufficient curve detection and line tracking accuracy?
Is the chosen wheel track and radius optimal for stability and turning performance?

intent: The geometry features a symmetric sensor array with five sensors: three front-centered and two wider outer sensors to enhance curve detection. The body dimensions and wheel track are chosen conservatively within bounds to ensure stability and maneuverability. The sensor size balances resolution and coverage. The mass is moderate to maintain agility while supporting robust control.
